versions.curl: curl 8.21.0 (Windows) libcurl/8.21.0 Schannel zlib/1.3.2 WinIDN WinLDAP

methodology: HTTP/1.1 loopback; deterministic payload; randomized order each repetition; one untimed warm-up per tool; end-to-end wall time includes startup, probes, disk writes, and internal fluxget hash; external hash for all tools outside timing; per-connection cap is synthetic, not aggregate bandwidth; no TLS or internet variability. Files are memory-cache friendly. Fluxget flushes checkpoints per chunk; curl/aria2 durability policies differ.
